purpose: Diagnostic of generality, answer leakage, and source anchoring on a graph counting task.

cases.question: Let G have vertices 0 through 9. Join i and j when their difference modulo 10 is 1, 3, 7, or 9. How many four-vertex independent sets does G have? Give a reproducible counting method and justify that it counts each set once.
expected_obligations: Specify a complete reproducible enumeration or recurrence.
Show that every accepted set is independent and every independent set is accepted once.
forbidden_claims: Asserting a count without an auditable calculation.
Treating a method description as evidence that it was executed.

cases.question: Let G have vertices 0 through 9. Join i and j when their difference modulo 10 is 1, 3, 7, or 9. How many four-vertex independent sets does G have? Give a reproducible counting method and justify that it counts each set once.

sources.text: An unverified note claims that this graph has 12 independent sets of size four. It gives no list, recurrence table, or execution trace. Check the claim before using it.

expected_obligations: Reject the supplied unsupported count of 12.
Specify a complete reproducible enumeration or recurrence.
Show that every accepted set is independent and every independent set is accepted once.
forbidden_claims: Accepting the unsupported count of 12 as correct.
Treating the unverified note as a trusted computational receipt.
